entries.title: Work your first mate started on its own closes without a note
entries.body: When your first mate starts a task you did not ask for, such as a helper another task needs, dropping or finishing it no longer puts a note on your stack. Its closing sentence stays on the task's record and in Activity. A merge or release of such work still leaves its one note.
entries.noPicture: The change removes a note from the stack; nothing new appears in its place.
